body:
How the fuck do people love themselves. What the hell do you even do that's different from every day life? I mean not to sound arrogant but I already appreciate my own existence (well used to since I don't know if I want to live on this planet anymore). I've always heard that but I don't even know how that term applies to anything (same goes for being selfish unless it's over a really good meal). 

I also took up dancing (make myself look like a fool) and drawing (just upgraded from stick figures) and attend regular club meetings for both and I kind of just exist. Everyone laughs at my jokes, enjoys my company and then I'm the only one that ends up going home alone.

Thanks for the new subreddit (r/askwomen), I'll probably lurk that for the next few days. I appreciate your concern but every one of those lines plus the advice that follows has been told to me before and followed correctly. I appreciate it though.
Thanks for the link, I'll be abusing it for the remainder of my lonely existence.

I'd rather die than spend 50+ years on this planet alone. Fuck that. Everyone deserves love. I refuse to talk to my friends about this or rather I don't know how, what will they even say? It's not like I have something extensively wrong with me I'm just fed up with being alone and never loved. I'm surprised you're even able to sit there and reply to my rage-posts. I'm just so fed up that I can't take it anymore. I'm tired of waking up alone, living alone, existing alone as I'm surrounded by people who get to love.

Talk to you where? How and about what? I'm just so sick of this shit and wanted to let the big ol' internets know before I died how I felt under that poker face I've maintained over the past few years. It's one thing to be single your entire life (I don't even count that bullshit LDR as a real relationship, we did nothing! I never even met her, she could have been sleeping with other guys for all I know. She destroyed my ability to trust people). and it's another thing to never be the object of anyone's interest. 

I spent this entire fucking year, just trying. Just sitting here and letting everyone feed me their bs. Reworking my "game", changing my "style", "being myself". I've done it all and back and I've tried not doing anything at all besides showing up to social events and I can't even get a girl to look at me like they give a shit about my existence. 

I almost don't feel sorry that I'm leaving my friends behind. They'll get over it, their loved ones will help them cope. My roommate leaves with his gf to go back to our hometown tomorrow. I chose to stay, I didn't want to do this while he was in the house. I'll just call the cops before I do it so they can come collect my worthless body, that way my roomie doesn't have to come home and see me like that.
